system.notes:
Gigantic scorpion-shaped robot with a laser cannon tail, miniguns, and sharp-bladed claws. Eradicate all living creatures.

AC 18, HP 49, ATK 2 claw +8 (2d8) or 1 chain gun (far) +8 (3d6) or 1 plasma lance, MV double near (climb), S +5, D +1, C +4, I +1, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 10

Delicate Machinery. Critical hits against robot do an extra die of damage. Takes double damage from lightning.

Force Field. Has 20 HP. Unless reduced to 0 HP, regains 2d6 HP a turn. Once reduced to 0 HP or if dispel magic is cast on robot, dormant for 24 hours.

Plasma Lance. A straight line (5' wide) extending far from robot. DEX 15+ or 4d6 damage.
